newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aerodata 1st half sunk by UK weather.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aerodata 1st half sunk by UK weather.

text.p: Airborne minerals exploration firm Aerodata Holdings Ltd said on Friday it posted a loss of A$1.5 million for the six months to December 31 compared to a profit of A$2.7 million in the previous corresponding half.
The company said the loss was a result of an exceptionally bad weather season in the United Kingdom and permitting problems in Indonesia as well as some other unforeseen events.
"Operational figures for the first two months of the second half indicate that the company should show an improvement in the next six months," Aerodata said in a statement.
Aerodata recently withdrew a takeover bid for British oil engineering services firm Scott Pickford Plc after Pickford agreed to merge with U.S. company Core Laboratories .
Aerodata shares closed nine cents weaker at 90 cents.
